B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that change a whole number into fractional units after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag simplification of a final fraction.

skills.name: Normalize whole/mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible standard form so whole and fractional parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly separated into whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary denominator conversion between equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing 1 from the whole part after an initial subtraction gives a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simple combining of final whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step performs both whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction together.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is first creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination only.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is combined with an existing fractional part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having 0 fractional parts.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3.
Do not tag subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is explicitly reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when a result such as 0/3 or 0/8 is rewritten as 0.
Tag when simplification occurs before or as part of the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining a whole number with an already simplified fractional part.
Do not tag normalization or denominator conversion steps.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fractional parts.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction unless the step also explicitly recombines parts for the final form.
Do not tag denominator alignment or borrowing.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions to match denominators.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching with explicit equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with fractional subtraction.
Tag when a step explicitly separates or identifies whole and fractional parts to prepare for mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator matching alone.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts once the forms are already prepared.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts are subtracted in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when fraction parts are subtracted after denominators are already the same or after normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification of the final result.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when a borrowed whole is rewritten as d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d before any need to borrow arises.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an equivalent whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final numeric form is made irreducible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification also occurs in that step.
Do not tag normalization or denominator matching.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when whole and fractional differences are explicitly combined into the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps before recombination.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts.
Do not tag single-fraction problems that end immediately after subtraction with no recombination of parts.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step rewrites one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless equivalent-fraction conversion to a common denominator is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form, such as n + 0/d or a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus zero fractional part, such as 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when the step explicitly separates or identifies whole and fractional parts to prepare for partwise subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between fractions.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fractional parts.
Do not tag combining final parts into the answer unless a rewrite/preparation occurs in that same step.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole and fractional parts separately once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when fraction parts are subtracted separately after denominators are already matched.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of a whole number as n + 0/d unless a later borrowing step is explicitly performed.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when a result like 0/3 is rewritten as 0.
Tag when the final numeric form is changed from a non-simplified fraction to a simpler equivalent value.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms fraction with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts into a mixed number unless simplification also occurs in that step.
Do not tag normalization before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when whole and zero fractional part are combined into an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps before recombination.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts.
Do not tag single-fraction problems that end immediately after subtraction unless a separate combine/final-form step is shown.
